implication: Compute budget is limited compared with cloud or workstation
recommended_design_decision: Design for reproducible local workflows rather than cloud-scale orchestration

implication: Large concurrent LLMs or large neural architecture searches are impractical
recommended_design_decision: Use one local quantized LLM as shared reasoning core

implication: Multiple large agents or large in-memory datasets may exceed memory
recommended_design_decision: Prefer sequential agent orchestration and compact intermediate outputs

implication: Reasoning can run locally but latency and context are constrained
recommended_design_decision: Keep prompts and agent outputs compact and auditable

implication: LLM is inefficient for numeric computation
recommended_design_decision: Use Python scripts for data processing modeling audits and metrics

implication: LLM context is temporary and limited
recommended_design_decision: Use Markdown documents and CSV registries as durable agent memory

implication: Ad hoc cloud-only workflows reduce reproducibility
recommended_design_decision: Prefer deterministic scripts tracked summaries and documented governance

implication: Local compute makes broad architecture search costly and scientifically risky
recommended_design_decision: Avoid unnecessary architecture search; require hypothesis and governance before testing
